title: Nine Years of Thursdays
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：afternoon　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 afternoon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother gave up ① an afternoon a week to a man who could not hear her, and said it was the best part of it. The ② afternoon, meaning the hours and not the visits, was nine years long in total, by her counting; an afternoon, she said, is the only part of a day that admits it has nothing else to do. She said the mornings never admit anything.

Every ③ afternoon in that house had a job, and the job changed at four o'clock. Their ④ afternoon on Thursdays was nine minutes' walk and two flights of stairs; an afternoon, my mother said, is the only appointment you can keep by doing nothing in particular. She said the stairs were the difficult half.

My grandfather said the word meant the other thing later: he was in ⑤ the afternoon of his life in 1974, and he said that without any sadness at all. The ⑥ afternoon, meaning the late part of a thing and not the hours after noon, is the only metaphor everybody uses and nobody notices; an afternoon, my father said, is either a time of day or a way of saying nearly finished. He said his father preferred the second.

By 1968 the ⑦ afternoon had been moved to Wednesdays and shortened by nine minutes, and she said the shortening was the whole tragedy. The ⑧ afternoon she missed was in June, and she never said why; an afternoon, my mother said, is the smallest thing you can give somebody and the easiest thing to take back. She said that was said without blame.

The ⑨ afternoon I remember is a Thursday in 1963, when it rained and she stayed anyway. An ⑩ afternoon, she said in 1971, is the only thing you can give away without losing it, because it was never yours; every afternoon, she said, belongs to whoever needs it most. She said she had given away nine hundred of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 下午（一段时间）
B. n. 下午（指那几个小时，与拜访相对）
C. n. 下午（指星期四那一个）
D. 固定搭配：give up an afternoon 腾出一个下午
E. n. 下午（比喻：事物的后期、晚年）
F. n. 后期；晚期（抽象比喻）
G. n. 下午（指她缺席的那一个）
H. n. 下午（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The afternoon, meaning the hours and not the visits
The afternoon, meaning the late part of a thing
the afternoon had been moved to Wednesdays

answers.why: give up an afternoon 意为“腾出一个下午”，1961 年起祖母每周腾出一个下午给一位听不见她说话的人，说那是其中最好的部分。
afternoon 指“那几个小时”，与拜访相对，按她的算法，这些下午加起来长达九年。
afternoon 意为“下午”，那屋里每一个下午都有一件活，四点钟活就换了。
afternoon 指星期四那一个，他们星期四那个下午是走九分钟、爬两段楼梯。
afternoon 为比喻义，意为“事物的后期、晚年”，1974 年祖父说自己到了人生的下午，说这话时毫无伤感。
afternoon 意为“后期、晚期（抽象比喻）”，指正午之后那几个小时之外的事物后段，它是人人都用、却没人注意的比喻。
afternoon 意为“下午”，到 1968 年这个下午被挪到星期三，还缩掉了九分钟，她说缩掉的那部分就是全部的悲剧。
afternoon 指她缺席的那一个，她缺席的那个下午在六月，她从来没说为什么。
afternoon 意为“下午”，我记得的是 1963 年一个下雨的星期四下午，她照样去了。
afternoon 为抽象总称，泛指“下午这种东西”，她说下午是你唯一可以送掉而自己并不失去的东西，因为它从来就不是你的。
